answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 9726 Country: India Title: Asslaam Alaikum, after voting there is voting mark on thumb remain. plz tell me can we offer namaaz with this mark on thumb. Question: Asslaam Alaikum, after voting there is voting mark on thumb remain. plz tell me can we offer namaaz with this mark on thumb. Answer ID: 9726 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1312/1312=M/1429) If it is possible to remove it, so one should do so. There is no wrong if the impression remains after removing the substance. You can pray in that condition. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
